text:
𝗧𝗢𝗦𝗦 𝗨𝗣𝗗𝗔𝗧𝗘! 🏏🇦🇺

Australia won the toss and will bat first in the 2nd T20I at Carrara. Unchanged XI; James Coles debuts for England in place of Will Jacks.

Aus lead 1-0. Who wins today? 👇

#AUSvENG #Cricket

👉 Carrara mein 2nd T20I: Mitchell Marsh ne toss jeeta aur pehle batting chuni
👉 Australia ki playing XI mein koi badlav nahi
👉 England ke liye James Coles ka debut, Will Jacks ki jagah
👉 Australia series mein 1-0 se aage

Kaun jeetega aaj ka match? Comment karo 👇
